packageRules.description: The cargo-chef base (the image's compiler) and rust-toolchain.toml (CI's) are one decision. Renovate's native rust-toolchain manager bumped the pin alone, automerged, while the base tag was untracked (HL-348). Not automerged: PR CI never builds the image, so green on the PR proves nothing about the base.

customManagers.description: Tracks the Dockerfile's lukemathwalker/cargo-chef:latest-rust-X.Y.Z-alpine tag, which the dockerfile manager cannot version, under depName rust so the group moves it with rust-toolchain.toml (HL-348).
